backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing access control, user profiles, file storage with blob registry, travel styles CRUD, and HTTP outcalls with migration support.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that preserves userProfiles from old actor and initializes empty travelStyles map for new actor schema.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three implemented features for admin image upload, Instagram story generation with Gotham font overlay, and quiz results display with download capability.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend components including blog, shop, quiz, admin dashboard, and various managers with multi-language support and CRUD operations.
frontend/.gitignore: Git ignore file excluding node_modules, build outputs, environment files, IDE configs, OS files, and deployment logs except .gitkeep.
frontend/deploy-logs/.gitkeep: Empty placeholder file to preserve the deploy-logs directory in version control.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Travel Butts Website React application with root div and module script reference.
frontend/scripts/deploy.ts: Main deployment orchestrator running backend bindings generation, frontend build, and canister deployment with retry logic, failure logging, and redaction.
frontend/scripts/deploySteps.ts: Deployment step executor spawning shell commands with stdout/stderr capture and transient failure detection for network errors and rate limits.
frontend/scripts/README.md: Documentation for deployment scripts providing reliable, rerunnable deployment with automatic retry and diagnostics.
frontend/scripts/redaction.ts: Log redaction utility removing sensitive data like API keys, bearer tokens, PEM blocks, principal IDs, emails, and credential URLs from deployment logs.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component with LanguageProvider, routing logic for all pages, authentication state, profile setup modal, and conditional rendering based on URL hash.
frontend/src/components/BlogPostModal.ts: Modal component for creating and editing blog posts with form fields for title, content, excerpt, author, cover image, tags, categories, and scheduled publishing. Includes timezone conversion utilities (Amsterdam to UTC) and image upload functionality with validation.
frontend/src/components/BlogSection.tsx: Displays blog posts and Instagram feed items in a tabbed interface with auto-playing video support for Instagram content. Includes admin controls for creating posts, view count display, and date formatting with multi-language support.
frontend/src/components/BlogViewModal.ts: Modal for viewing individual blog posts with formatted content, metadata (author, dates, tags, categories), cover images, and view count display. Converts markdown images to HTML and shows publication status.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Contact form section with input fields for name, email, subject, message, and consent checkbox. Displays contact information (email, phone, location) with icons and submits form data via mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying brand description, quick navigation links, and social media icons (Instagram, TikTok, Buy Me a Coffee). Includes multi-language support and navigation handlers.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Main navigation header component with logo, menu items (Home, Blog, Shop, Travel Tools dropdown), language selector, login button, and admin access. Includes mobile responsive menu and periodic logo refresh.
frontend/src/components/HeroImageUploade: Admin component for uploading hero images with file validation (JPG/PNG/WebP/SVG, max 10MB), preview functionality, and status feedback. Uploads to 'assets/hero-image.jpg' path.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Homepage hero section with responsive layouts (desktop split-screen, tablet stacked, mobile optimized) displaying hero image and travel tools grid. Includes admin upload interface and periodic image refresh.
frontend/src/components/InstagramFeedMan: Admin interface for managing Instagram feed items with CRUD operations, supporting image/video uploads (max 50MB videos, 10MB images), captions, links, and preview functionality with video playback controls.
frontend/src/components/LanguageSelector: Dropdown language selector component supporting English, Dutch, German, French, and Spanish with flag icons and click-outside-to-close behavior.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button component using Internet Identity for login/logout with loading states and query cache clearing on logout.
frontend/src/components/LogoUploader.tsx: Admin component for uploading site logo with file validation (JPG/PNG/WebP/SVG, max 10MB), current logo display, and status feedback. Uploads to 'assets/travel-butts-logo.png' path.
frontend/src/components/PackingListManag: Admin component for managing customizable packing list templates with categories (clothing, footwear, toiletries with gender-specific subcategories), items, and default selections. Provides CRUD operations and reordering functionality for packing list items.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal component for initial user profile setup that collects name, email, newsletter preference, and language selection. Includes form validation and integrates with the language context to set user's preferred language.
frontend/src/components/quiz/QuizActionB: Reusable button component for quiz actions with multiple style variants (primary, secondary, gradient, brand) and icon support. Handles disabled states and consistent styling.
frontend/src/components/quiz/quizBrandVa: Centralized style configuration object defining consistent brand colors, states, and animation classes for all quiz components (buttons, options, cards, progress bars, results).
frontend/src/components/quiz/QuizCard.ts: Container component for quiz content with white or brand-themed variants and optional fade-in animation.
frontend/src/components/quiz/QuizOptionB: Quiz answer option button with states for selected, correct, incorrect, and disabled. Shows visual feedback with icons and color coding for answer validation.
frontend/src/components/quiz/QuizPage.ts: Page wrapper component for quiz screens with centered max-width layout and optional brand variant styling.
frontend/src/components/quiz/QuizProgres: Progress bar component showing current question number, total questions, and percentage completion with animated transitions and brand styling options.
frontend/src/components/quiz/QuizResultS: Container component for displaying quiz results with centered layout, shadow styling, and optional animation support.
frontend/src/components/QuizManager.tsx: Admin interface for managing two quiz types: geography quiz (flags/capitals) and travel style quiz (personality archetypes). Includes file upload for images, CRUD operations, and defines travel archetypes with traits and descriptions.
frontend/src/components/ShopProductManag: Admin dashboard for managing shop products with full CRUD operations, multi-image upload, pricing, affiliate links, and product status flags (published, popular). Displays products in a grid with formatting for dates and prices.
frontend/src/components/ShopProductModal: Modal form component for creating/editing shop products with fields for title, description, price, affiliate link, images, and status flags. Handles image uploads with validation and integrates with file storage and product mutation hooks.
frontend/src/components/ShopSection.tsx: Displays a grid of shop products with modal details, image carousel, admin controls for adding products, and affiliate link purchase buttons. Handles product filtering, date/price formatting, and integrates with backend queries for product data.
frontend/src/components/ToastContainer.t: Renders toast notifications in the top-right corner with different styles (success, error, warning, info) and auto-dismiss functionality. Subscribes to the toast manager for real-time updates.
Displays a responsive grid of six travel tool cards (Trip Randomizer, Shop, Train vs Flight, Packing List, Geography Quiz, Travel Style Quiz) with different layouts for desktop, tablet, and mobile. Each card links to its corresponding section.
frontend/src/components/UserManagement.t: Admin interface for managing users, displaying user profiles with principal IDs, roles (admin/user), newsletter subscription status, and allowing role changes with confirmation dialogs. Includes clipboard copy functionality for user details.
frontend/src/contexts/LanguageContext.ts: Provides a React context for multi-language support (en, nl, de, fr, es) with localStorage persistence and a translation dictionary containing UI strings for navigation, tools, blog, shop, and other sections.
frontend/src/features/travelStyleQuiz/ge: Contains a database of travel destinations mapped to travel archetypes (Thrill Seeker, Culture Connoisseur, Chill Escapist, etc.) with descriptions and tags for each destination.
frontend/src/features/travelStyleQuiz/id: Defines TypeScript interfaces for Destination objects and DestinationsResponse with loading and error states.
frontend/src/features/travelStyleQuiz/pa: Provides packing list recommendations (essentials, what you need, often forgotten items) tailored to different travel archetypes based on primary and secondary personality types.
frontend/src/features/travelStyleQuiz/pe: Returns personality profile descriptions with bullet points and callouts for each travel archetype, describing their travel values, decision-making style, and preferences.
frontend/src/features/travelStyleQuiz/us: Custom React hook that memoizes and returns ideal destinations based on primary and secondary travel archetypes using the getIdealDestinations function.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that manages backend actor creation with Internet Identity authentication, using React Query for caching and automatically invalidating dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication on ICP, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for data fetching and mutations, including admin checks, user profiles, blog posts, contact submissions, email captures, Instagram feeds, shop products, travel styles, packing lists, and quiz management with proper caching and invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Tailwind, defines custom CSS variables for the color palette (primary white, secondary teal, accent colors), sets up custom utility classes, scrollbar styles, animations, and hover effects for the application.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient provider for React Query and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication, then renders the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Comprehensive admin dashboard component with tabs for managing blog posts, contacts, users, travel tools, media uploads, Instagram feed, shop products, quizzes, packing lists, and settings with role-based access control.
frontend/src/pages/BlogDetailPage.tsx: Blog post detail view component that displays a single blog post with metadata (date, author, tags, view count), renders markdown content with image support, includes share functionality, and increments view count on load.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPage.tsx: Blog listing page with pagination (12 posts per page), displays blog posts in a grid with thumbnails, metadata, view counts, and multi-language support with navigation controls for browsing through pages.
frontend/src/pages/GeographyQuiz.tsx: Geography quiz page with flag and capital questions for countries worldwide, featuring quiz progress tracking, Instagram story generation, and score sharing functionality.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main landing page component that composes HeroSection, BlogSection, ShopSection, and ContactSection with alternating background colors.
frontend/src/pages/PackingList.tsx: Interactive packing list tool with categorized items (clothing, footwear, toiletries, etc.), custom item support, search/filter functionality, and export/share capabilities.
frontend/src/pages/ShopPage.tsx: E-commerce page displaying published shop products with search, sorting, detailed product modals with image galleries, and affiliate link integration.
frontend/src/pages/TrainVsFlightPrices.t: Comparison tool for train versus flight options showing mock data for routes with pricing, duration, and travel details for both transportation modes.
frontend/src/pages/TravelStyleQuiz.tsx: Personality quiz that determines user's travel archetype (Thrill Seeker, Culture Connoisseur, etc.) with results showing personality profile, ideal destinations, and packing recommendations.
frontend/src/pages/TripRandomizer.tsx: React component for a trip randomizer feature that displays mock flight and hotel data with carousel navigation, destination highlights, and booking functionality.
frontend/src/utils/instagramStoryGenerat: Utility that generates Instagram Story images (1080x1920) on canvas with brand gradients, decorative elements, custom backgrounds, logo overlay, and text content for quiz results.
frontend/src/utils/toast.ts: Toast notification manager implementing a pub-sub pattern with show, remove, and clear methods supporting success, error, info, and warning types with auto-dismiss.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom OKLCH color variables, sidebar colors, border radius tokens, animations, and typography/container-queries plugins.
project_state.json: Project state tracking document showing a travel style quiz app with Instagram story generation features, including admin image upload capability and text overlay system using Gotham Medium font.
